formulas.name: Lagrange's Theorem
formulas.symbols: [G:H]: the index (number of distinct left cosets of H in G).
formulas.whenToUse: Ruling out impossible subgroup orders, or computing an index.
formulas.commonMistake: Treating this as an iff — the converse (a subgroup of every divisor order exists) is false in general.

formulas.name: Subgroup Test
formulas.formula: a*b^{-1}\in H\ \forall a,b\in H \iff H\le G
formulas.symbols: H: a non-empty subset of G.
formulas.conditions: H must be non-empty to start.
formulas.whenToUse: Verifying a candidate subgroup in one step.
formulas.commonMistake: Checking only closure (a*b\in H) and forgetting inverses.
